t0_rule: Only evidence first observed by Wallet500 at or before the exact-pair feature snapshot T0 is eligible. Post-T0 evidence is excluded.

winners.note: Zero means no timestamp-safe exact-token evidence in the current immutable ledger; it is not proof that the real-world signal did not exist.

controls.note: Zero means no timestamp-safe exact-token evidence in the current immutable ledger; it is not proof that the real-world signal did not exist.

coverage_guard: Sparse historical social/KOL/listing ledgers are reported as insufficient coverage, never imputed as zero alpha.
